ingredients: Basmati rice, carrot, green peas, onion, garlic, oil, cumin seeds, bay leaf, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, turmeric powder, garam masala, salt, water
instructions: Wash and soak rice for 15 minutes and drain excess water. Heat oil in a deep pan on medium heat and add cumin seeds and whole spices until aromatic. Add sliced onion and saut until light golden brown, then add garlic and saut briefly. Add chopped carrot and peas and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add turmeric, garam masala, and salt and mix well. Add soaked rice and gently stir to coat with spices. Add water, bring to a boil, cover, and cook on low heat until rice is fully cooked and water is absorbed. Switch off heat, rest for a few minutes, fluff gently, and serve hot.

ingredients: Paneer, butter, oil, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cashew nuts, red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, coriander powder, kasuri methi, fresh cream, salt, water
instructions: Heat butter and a little oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped onion until soft and light golden. Add ginger and garlic and saut briefly until fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and cashew nuts and cook until tomatoes turn soft and oil begins to separate. Cool the mixture slightly and blend into a smooth puree. Return the puree to the pan, add red chili powder, turmeric, coriander powder, garam masala, and salt, and cook until the gravy thickens. Add paneer cubes and mix gently to coat with the gravy. Pour in water as needed for consistency, add cream and crushed kasuri methi, and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, oil, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, green chili, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, cumin seeds, bay leaf, salt, water
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and add cumin seeds and bay leaf until aromatic. Add finely chopped onion and saut until golden brown. Add ginger, garlic, and green chili and saut briefly until fragrant. Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, and salt and cook for a few seconds. Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned and coated with spices. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and oil starts separating from the masala. Add water, mix well, cover, and simmer on low heat until chicken is fully cooked and gravy thickens. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

ingredients: Potato, cauliflower, oil, onion, ginger, garlic, green chili, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and add cumin seeds until they crackle. Add chopped onion and saut until light golden. Add ginger, garlic, and green chili and saut briefly until fragrant. Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt and mix well. Add diced potatoes and cauliflower florets and toss to coat with spices. Cover and cook on low heat, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender. Uncover and cook further until potatoes and cauliflower are lightly roasted. Sprinkle garam masala, mix gently, and serve hot.

ingredients: Pasta, oil, onion, garlic, carrot, beans, tomato, salt, black pepper, chili flakes, mixed Italian herbs, water
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente and drain, reserving a little cooking water. Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped garlic until fragrant. Add sliced onion and cook until soft. Add chopped carrot and beans and cook until vegetables are tender. Add chopped tomatoes, salt, black pepper, chili flakes, and mixed Italian herbs and cook until slightly saucy. Add boiled pasta and a little reserved pasta water and toss well. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until everything is well combined and serve warm.

ingredients: Pasta, chicken, butter, olive oil, garlic, fresh cream, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, water
instructions: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente and drain, reserving some pasta water. Heat butter and a little olive oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped garlic until fragrant. Add chicken pieces seasoned with salt and pepper and cook until fully cooked and lightly golden. Lower the heat and pour in fresh cream, stirring gently to form a smooth sauce. Add grated parmesan cheese and Italian herbs and mix until the sauce thickens slightly. Add cooked pasta and a little reserved pasta water and toss until well coated. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

ingredients: Pizza base, tomato, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, dried oregano, fresh basil
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Crush or blend tomatoes with garlic, salt, and black pepper to form a simple sauce. Place the pizza base on a baking tray and spread the tomato sauce evenly. Add grated or sliced mozzarella cheese evenly on top. Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle dried oregano. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust turns crisp. Garnish with fresh basil, slice, and serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, oil, garlic, spring onion, carrot, green peas, soy sauce, black pepper, salt
instructions: Cook rice and spread it on a plate to cool completely. Heat oil in a wok on high heat and saut chopped garlic until aromatic. Add carrot and green peas and stir fry on high heat until slightly tender. Add cooled cooked rice and toss well to separate the grains. Add soy sauce, black pepper, and salt and stir fry for a few minutes until evenly mixed. Add chopped spring onion, mix well, and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, corn flour, all-purpose flour, oil, garlic, ginger, green chili, onion, spring onion, soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, black pepper, salt, water
instructions: Mix chicken pieces with corn flour, all-purpose flour, salt, and black pepper to form a light coating. Heat oil and deep fry the chicken until crisp and golden, then drain excess oil. Heat a little oil in another pan on high heat and saut chopped garlic, ginger, and green chili until aromatic. Add sliced onion and stir fry briefly until slightly crunchy. Add soy sauce, chili sauce, vinegar, and a little water and mix well. Add fried chicken pieces and toss to coat evenly with the sauce. Cook for a few minutes until the sauce thickens, garnish with spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Noodles, oil, garlic, spring onion, carrot, cabbage, soy sauce, black pepper, salt, water
instructions: Boil noodles in salted water until just cooked and drain completely. Heat oil in a wok on high heat and saut chopped garlic until aromatic. Add carrot and cabbage and stir fry on high heat until slightly tender but still crunchy. Add boiled noodles and toss well to combine with vegetables. Add soy sauce, black pepper, and salt and stir fry for a few minutes until evenly mixed. Add chopped spring onion, toss once more, and serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla, chicken, oil, onion, tomato, garlic, cumin powder, chili powder, salt, cheese, coriander leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped garlic and onion until soft. Add chicken pieces, cumin powder, chili powder, and salt and cook until chicken is fully cooked and lightly browned. Warm tortillas on a separate pan. Fill tortillas with chicken, tomato, and cheese. Garnish with coriander, fold, and serve hot.

ingredients: Cooked avocado, onion, tomato, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, coriander leaves, cumin powder (optional)
instructions: Mash ripe avocado in a bowl until smooth. Add finely chopped onion, tomato, and coriander leaves and mix well. Add lemon juice, salt, black pepper, and a pinch of cumin powder if using, and stir until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or lemon juice as needed. Serve immediately with tortilla chips or as a sandwich spread.

ingredients: Bread slices, butter, carrot, cucumber, tomato, lettuce, cheese, salt, black pepper
instructions: Spread butter evenly on each bread slice. Layer thinly sliced carrot, cucumber, tomato, lettuce, and cheese between the slices. Sprinkle a little salt and black pepper on the vegetables. Grill or toast the sandwich on a pan or sandwich maker until the bread is golden and the cheese melts slightly. Cut the sandwich into halves or desired shapes and serve warm.

ingredients: Bread slices, chicken, butter, cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, mayonnaise, salt, black pepper, olive oil
instructions: Season chicken with salt and black pepper and cook in a pan with a little olive oil until fully cooked. Slice the cooked chicken thinly. Butter bread slices evenly on one side. Place lettuce, tomato slices, onion slices, and the cooked chicken on one slice of bread. Add cheese and a thin layer of mayonnaise, then cover with the second slice of bread. Grill the sandwich on a pan or sandwich maker until the bread is crisp and golden and the cheese melts. Cut into halves and serve hot.

ingredients: Carrot, beans, onion, garlic, oil, celery, potato, salt, black pepper, parsley, water, vegetable stock cube (optional)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot on medium heat and saut chopped onion, garlic, and celery until fragrant. Add chopped carrot, beans, and potato and cook briefly for 23 minutes. Pour in water (and vegetable stock if using) and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer on low for 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are soft. Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped parsley. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, onion, garlic, oil, carrot, celery, salt, black pepper, parsley, bay leaf, water, chicken stock cube (optional)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot on medium heat and saut chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and cook briefly until lightly browned. Pour in water (and chicken stock if using) and add a bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until chicken is fully cooked and vegetables are tender. Season with salt, black pepper, and chopped parsley. Remove bay leaf and serve hot.

ingredients: Cooked chickpeas, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, tahini, salt, black pepper, cumin powder (optional), paprika, water
instructions: Place cooked chickpeas, chopped garlic, tahini, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and a pinch of cumin powder in a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy, adding a little water if needed for consistency. Taste and adjust seasoning with more salt or lemon juice if necessary. Transfer to a serving bowl, drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle paprika on top. Serve fresh with pita bread or vegetables.

ingredients: Chickpeas, onion, garlic, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili powder, salt, baking powder, oil, parsley, coriander leaves
instructions: Soak chickpeas overnight and drain. Grind chickpeas with chopped onion, garlic, cumin powder, coriander powder, chili powder, salt, baking powder, parsley, and coriander leaves to form a coarse paste. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties. Heat oil in a pan and deep fry or shallow fry the balls until golden brown and crisp. Drain excess oil on paper towels and serve hot with dipping sauce.

ingredients: Eggs, tomato, onion, garlic, oil, bell pepper, cumin powder, paprika, chili powder, salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped onion, garlic, and bell pepper until soft. Add chopped tomatoes, cumin powder, paprika, chili powder, salt, and black pepper and cook until the sauce thickens slightly. Make small wells in the sauce and crack eggs into the wells. Cover the pan and cook on low heat until eggs are set to your preference. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: Mushrooms, onion, garlic, oil, soy sauce, black pepper, spring onions (optional), sesame seeds (optional)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan on medium heat and saut chopped onion and garlic until fragrant. Add sliced mushrooms and stir-fry for 45 minutes until soft but not soggy. Add soy sauce and black pepper and toss to coat evenly. Garnish with chopped spring onions and sesame seeds if desired. Serve hot.

ingredients: Fish fillets, onion, tomato, garlic, ginger, oil, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, salt, black pepper, fresh coriander, water
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and saut chopped onion, garlic, and ginger until golden. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt and cook for 1 minute. Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft and oil separates. Gently place fish fillets into the sauce and add a little water. Simmer on low heat for 810 minutes until fish is fully cooked. Garnish with chopped coriander and serve hot with rice or bread.

ingredients: Semolina (rava), onion, carrot, green peas, green chili, ginger, curry leaves, oil, salt, mustard seeds, water, coriander leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds. Once they splutter, add chopped onion, green chili, ginger, and curry leaves. Sauteee until onion turns soft. Add chopped carrot and peas and cook for 23 minutes. Roast semolina separately for 23 minutes until light golden. Boil water in a pot with salt, then slowly add roasted semolina while stirring to avoid lumps. Cook on low heat until thick and soft. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves and serve hot.

ingredients: Basmati rice, chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, yogurt, garam masala, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin seeds, oil, salt, saffron (optional), water, fresh coriander and mint leaves
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin, and salt for at least 30 minutes. Cook onions until golden and saut garlic and ginger paste. Add marinated chicken and cook until partially done. Boil basmati rice until 70% cooked. Layer rice and chicken in a deep pan, sprinkle garam masala, saffron, and fresh coriander and mint leaves. Cover and cook on low heat (dum) for 20 to 25 minutes until chicken and rice are fully cooked. Serve hot.

ingredients: Carrot, beans, potato, onion, peas, cream, cashew paste, oil, cumin seeds, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala, salt, water, fresh coriander
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Sauteee chopped onion until soft. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Cook for 12 minutes. Add chopped vegetables and mix well. Cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes. Add cream and cashew paste, stir gently, and simmer for 57 minutes until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot.

ingredients: Tomato, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, sugar (optional), basil leaves, water, cream (optional)
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and saut chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 57 minutes until soft. Add water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend the mixture until smooth. Return to pot, add salt, black pepper, sugar if needed, and simmer for 23 minutes. Add cream if desired. Garnish with basil leaves and serve hot.

ingredients: Bread slices, butter, garlic, parsley (optional), salt, black pepper, olive oil
instructions: Preheat oven or toaster. Mix softened butter with minced garlic, chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper. Spread garlic butter evenly on bread slices. Toast or bake slices until golden and crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Pizza base, chicken, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, onion, bell pepper, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C. Spread tomato sauce evenly on the pizza base. Add cooked chicken pieces, sliced onion, bell pepper, and sprinkle salt, black pepper, and Italian herbs. Cover with mozzarella cheese and drizzle olive oil on top. Bake for 1215 minutes until cheese melts and crust is crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Lasagna sheets, tomato, carrot, beans, zucchini, bell pepper, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, olive oil, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C. Boil lasagna sheets until al dente. Sauteee chopped vegetables in olive oil with salt, black pepper, and Italian herbs until slightly soft. Layer lasagna sheets, vegetable mixture, ricotta, and mozzarella in a baking dish. Repeat layers. Top with mozzarella cheese and bake for 3035 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, garlic, oil, soy sauce, Schezwan sauce, green chili, bell pepper, onion, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a wok on high heat and saut minced garlic until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and stir-fry until lightly browned. Add chopped onion, bell pepper, and green chili and stir-fry for 23 minutes. Add soy sauce, Schezwan sauce, salt, and black pepper and toss everything to coat the chicken evenly. Cook for another 34 minutes until chicken is fully cooked. Serve hot.

ingredients: All-purpose flour, water, cabbage, carrot, garlic, spring onion, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, black pepper, oil
instructions: Prepare dough by mixing flour and water until smooth. Let it rest for 15 to 20 minutes. Finely chop cabbage, carrot, garlic, and spring onions. Mix with soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to make filling. Roll dough into small circles, place 12 teaspoons of filling in the center, and fold into dumplings. Heat water in a steamer and steam dumplings for 810 minutes until cooked. Serve hot with soy sauce or chili sauce.

ingredients: All-purpose flour, water, chicken, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, spring onion, salt, black pepper, oil
instructions: Prepare dough by mixing flour and water until smooth. Rest for 15 to 20 minutes. Finely chop chicken, garlic, ginger, and spring onions. Mix with soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper to make filling. Roll dough into small circles, place filling in center, and fold into dumplings. Steam dumplings for 10 to 12 minutes until chicken is fully cooked. Serve hot with chili sauce or soy sauce.

ingredients: Tortilla, cooked beans, onion, tomato, cheese, olive oil, chili powder, cumin powder, salt, black pepper, lettuce, sour cream (optional)
instructions: Heat a pan with a little olive oil and saut chopped onion and tomato until soft. Add cooked beans, chili powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 23 minutes. Warm tortillas on a pan. Place a portion of the bean mixture on the tortilla, sprinkle grated cheese, and add lettuce and sour cream if desired. Roll the tortilla tightly and serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla, chicken, onion, tomato, cheese, olive oil, chili powder, cumin powder, salt, black pepper, lettuce, sour cream (optional)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and saut chopped onion until soft. Add chicken pieces, chili powder, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook until chicken is fully done. Warm tortillas on a pan. Place chicken mixture on the tortilla, add tomato slices, cheese, lettuce, and sour cream if desired. Roll the tortilla tightly and serve hot.

ingredients: Corn chips, shredded cheese, tomato, onion, jalapeno (optional), chili powder, salt, black pepper, sour cream (optional), coriander leaves (optional)
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C. Arrange corn chips evenly on a baking tray. Top with chopped tomato, onion, and jalapeno if using. Sprinkle shredded cheese, chili powder, salt, and black pepper evenly. Bake for 810 minutes until cheese melts. Garnish with sour cream and coriander leaves if desired. Serve hot.

ingredients: Cucumber, tomato, onion, olive oil, feta cheese, black olives, salt, black pepper, lemon juice, oregano
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomato, and onion into bite-sized pieces. Crumble feta cheese over the vegetables and add black olives. Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt, black pepper, and oregano. Toss gently and serve fresh.

ingredients: Fish fillets, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, paprika, parsley (optional)
instructions: Marinate fish fillets with minced garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika for 15 to 20 minutes. Preheat grill or oven to 200C. Place fish on the grill or baking tray and cook for 57 minutes on each side until fully cooked and lightly charred. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: Eggs, onion, carrot, bell pepper, salt, black pepper, oil, milk (optional), parsley (optional)
instructions: Beat eggs in a bowl with a little salt, black pepper, and milk if using. Chop onion, carrot, and bell pepper finely. Heat oil in a pan and saut vegetables briefly. Pour beaten eggs over the vegetables and cook on medium-low heat until set. Flip carefully to cook the other side if desired. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: Flatbread, chicken, onion, garlic, olive oil, paprika, cumin powder, chili powder, salt, black pepper, lettuce, tomato, yogurt sauce (optional)
instructions: Mix chicken with paprika, cumin, chili powder, salt, black pepper, and olive oil. Heat a pan and cook chicken until fully done. Warm flatbread on a pan. Place cooked chicken, sliced onion, tomato, and lettuce on flatbread. Add yogurt sauce if desired, roll tightly, and serve hot.

ingredients: Flatbread, carrot, cabbage, onion, garlic, bell pepper, olive oil, paprika, cumin powder, salt, black pepper, lettuce, yogurt sauce (optional)
instructions: Chop carrot, cabbage, onion, garlic, and bell pepper finely. Heat olive oil in a pan and saut garlic and onion until fragrant. Add remaining vegetables, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 45 minutes until slightly soft. Warm flatbread on a pan. Place cooked vegetables and lettuce on flatbread, add yogurt sauce if desired. Roll tightly and serve hot.

ingredients: Lentils (red or yellow), onion, garlic, carrot, celery (optional), olive oil, salt, black pepper, cumin powder, turmeric, water, lemon juice, fresh coriander
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly. Heat olive oil in a pot and saut chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery until soft. Add cumin powder, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and saut for 1 minute. Add lentils and water (about 3 cups). Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until lentils are fully cooked and soft. Adjust consistency with water if needed. Blend partially or fully for a smooth texture. Add lemon juice, garnish with chopped coriander, and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken pieces (boneless), garlic, ginger, yogurt, chili powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, olive oil, lemon juice
instructions: Mix chicken with minced garlic, ginger, yogurt, chili powder, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, black pepper, olive oil, and lemon juice. Marinate for at least 1 hour or overnight for best flavor. Preheat grill or oven to 200C. Thread chicken pieces onto skewers. Grill for 810 minutes on each side until fully cooked and slightly charred. Serve hot with salad or yogurt sauce.

ingredients: Carrot, beans, potato, onion, garlic, oil, turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, garam masala, salt, water, fresh coriander
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and saut chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add turmeric, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 12 minutes. Add chopped carrots, beans, and potato. Mix well. Pour in enough water to cover vegetables. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until vegetables are tender. Sprinkle garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander. Serve hot with rice or roti.

ingredients: Chicken breast, onion, garlic, bell pepper, soy sauce, olive oil, salt, black pepper, chili flakes (optional), spring onion for garnish
instructions: Cut chicken into thin strips. Heat olive oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and sliced onion, stir-fry for 12 minutes until fragrant. Add chicken strips and cook for 56 minutes until lightly browned. Add sliced bell pepper, soy sauce, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes if using. Stir-fry for 23 more minutes until chicken is fully cooked and vegetables are crisp-tender. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Potato, carrot, peas, green beans, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, cornflour, oil, salt, black pepper, chili powder, coriander leaves
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes. Steam or boil carrots, peas, and beans and chop finely. Mix mashed potatoes with vegetables, chopped onion, garlic, cornflour, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and coriander leaves. Shape mixture into small patties. Coat with breadcrumbs. Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry cutlets on medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with chutney or sauce.

ingredients: Chicken breast, boiled potato, onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, cornflour, oil, salt, black pepper, chili powder, egg
instructions: Boil and shred chicken. Mash boiled potato. Mix chicken, mashed potato, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and chili powder. Shape mixture into small patties. Coat with beaten egg and then breadcrumbs. Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry cutlets on medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot.

ingredients: All-purpose flour, milk, egg, butter, sugar, baking powder, salt, vanilla essence (optional), honey or syrup (optional)
instructions: In a bowl, mix flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. In another bowl, whisk egg with milk and melted butter. Add vanilla essence if using. Combine wet and dry ingredients and mix until smooth, avoiding lumps. Heat a non-stick pan on medium heat and grease lightly with butter. Pour batter onto pan and cook until bubbles appear on the surface, then flip and cook the other side until golden. Serve hot with honey, syrup, or fruits.

ingredients: Apple, banana, orange, grapes, kiwi (optional), honey or lemon juice, mint leaves (optional)
instructions: Wash and peel fruits if necessary. Chop all fruits into bite-sized pieces. Mix gently in a bowl. Add a little honey or lemon juice to enhance flavor. Garnish with mint leaves if desired. Serve fresh chilled.

ingredients: Cooked rice, chicken breast, garlic, onion, soy sauce, oil, green peas, carrot, black pepper, spring onion for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and chopped onion, saut until fragrant. Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned. Add chopped carrot and green peas, stir-fry for 23 minutes. Add cooked rice and soy sauce, tossing everything well for 34 minutes until heated through. Season with black pepper and garnish with spring onion. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flattened rice (poha), onion, green peas, carrot, green chili, curry leaves, mustard seeds, turmeric, oil, salt, lemon juice, coriander leaves
instructions: Rinse poha under water and drain completely. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds. Once they splutter, add curry leaves, chopped onion, green chili, and carrot. Sauteee until onion is soft. Add green peas, turmeric, and salt. Mix well. Add drained poha and toss gently to combine. Cook for 23 minutes on low heat. Add lemon juice and garnish with coriander leaves. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, split yellow lentils (moong dal), carrot, peas, beans (optional), ginger, green chili, cumin seeds, turmeric, oil or ghee, salt, water, coriander leaves
instructions: Rinse rice and lentils thoroughly. Chop carrot and beans into small pieces. Heat oil or ghee in a pressure cooker or pot. Add cumin seeds, chopped ginger, and green chili. Sauteee for 12 minutes. Add chopped vegetables, turmeric, and salt. Stir for 2 minutes. Add rice and lentils, pour water (about 3 cups for 1 cup rice and 1/2 cup lentils), mix well. Cook covered on low heat for 20 to 25 minutes or pressure cook for 23 whistles until rice and lentils are soft. Garnish with chopped coriander and serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

ingredients: Rice, split yellow lentils (moong dal), chicken pieces, ginger, garlic, green chili, cumin seeds, turmeric, oil, salt, water, coriander leaves
instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker or pot. Add cumin seeds, chopped ginger, garlic, and green chili. Sauteee until aromatic. Add chicken pieces, turmeric, and salt. Cook for 56 minutes until chicken changes color. Add rice and lentils, pour water (about 34 cups), mix well. Cook on low heat for 25 to 30 minutes or pressure cook for 34 whistles until chicken, rice, and lentils are soft. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.

ingredients: Whole wheat flour, boiled potato, carrot, peas (optional), onion, green chili, coriander leaves, salt, black pepper, oil or ghee
instructions: Prepare dough by mixing flour with water and a pinch of salt. Rest for 20 minutes. Boil and mash potato. Grate carrot and mix with mashed potato, chopped onion, green chili, coriander, salt, and pepper to make filling. Roll dough into small circles, place filling in center, fold edges, and roll again gently. Heat a pan and cook paratha on medium heat with oil or ghee until golden and crisp on both sides. Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

ingredients: Whole wheat flour, chicken, onion, green chili, garlic, coriander leaves, salt, black pepper, oil or ghee
instructions: Prepare dough by mixing flour with water and salt. Rest for 20 minutes. Cook chicken with chopped onion, garlic, green chili, coriander, salt, and pepper until fully done. Let it cool. Roll dough into small circles, place chicken filling in center, fold edges, and roll gently again. Heat pan and cook paratha with oil or ghee until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with chutney or yogurt.

ingredients: Parboiled rice, split urad dal (lentils), carrot, beans, green chili, ginger, salt, oil (for greasing idli molds), water
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 45 hours. Grind urad dal to smooth batter and rice to coarse batter. Mix both batters with salt, cover, and ferment for 810 hours. Chop carrot, beans, green chili, and ginger finely and mix into batter. Grease idli molds with oil. Pour batter into molds. Steam in an idli steamer or pressure cooker (without whistle) for 10 to 12 minutes until cooked. Remove and serve hot with coconut chutney or sambar.

ingredients: Chicken pieces, onion, garlic, carrot, potato, beans (optional), oil, salt, black pepper, bay leaf, cinnamon stick, water, coriander for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a pot. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add chicken pieces, salt, black pepper, bay leaf, and cinnamon stick. Cook for 56 minutes. Add chopped carrot, potato, and beans. Pour water to cover all ingredients. Bring to boil, then simmer on low heat for 20 to 25 minutes until chicken and vegetables are tender. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with bread or rice.

ingredients: Parboiled rice, split urad dal, oil, salt, carrot, beans, onion, green chili, coriander leaves (optional)
instructions: Soak rice and urad dal for 45 hours. Grind to smooth batter, mix, and ferment for 8 hours. Chop carrot, beans, onion, and green chili finely. Mix into batter or use as filling. Heat a non-stick pan or tawa. Pour a ladleful of batter and spread thinly. Drizzle oil around edges. Cook on medium heat until edges lift and base is crisp. Flip if desired. Serve hot with chutney or sambar.

ingredients: Arborio rice, chicken breast, onion, garlic, chicken stock, olive oil, butter, salt, black pepper, parmesan cheese, parsley
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until translucent. Add diced chicken and cook until lightly browned. Add Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes. Gradually pour warm chicken stock, stirring continuously until absorbed before adding more. Cook for 25 to 30 minutes until rice is creamy and chicken is fully cooked. Add parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: pizza dough,tomato,cheese,vegetables
instructions: Fill dough with vegetables and cheese. Bake until golden.

ingredients: Chicken breast, roasted peanuts, garlic, ginger, green chili, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, cornflour, sesame oil, vegetable oil, spring onion
instructions: Cut chicken into small cubes. Mix chicken with a little cornflour and salt. Heat vegetable oil in a wok on high heat. Stir-fry chicken until lightly golden and cooked. Remove and set aside. In the same wok, add chopped garlic, ginger, and green chili. Sauteee briefly. Add roasted peanuts, cooked chicken, soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, and a splash of water. Stir-fry on high heat for 23 minutes until sauce thickens. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with chopped spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Noodles, cabbage, carrot, capsicum, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, oil, salt, black pepper, chili sauce (optional)
instructions: Boil noodles until al dente, drain, and toss with a little oil to prevent sticking. Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and saut until fragrant. Add thinly sliced cabbage, carrot, and capsicum. Stir-fry for 23 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, salt, black pepper, and chili sauce if using. Toss everything well for 23 minutes. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken breast, onion, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, sugar, cornflour, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, coat lightly with cornflour, salt, and pepper. Heat oil in a pan and fry chicken until golden and cooked. Remove and set aside. In the same pan, saut minced garlic and ginger until aromatic. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, stir-fry for 23 minutes. Mix soy sauce, ketchup, vinegar, and sugar to make sweet-sour sauce. Add to the pan along with fried chicken. Toss well on high heat for 23 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve hot.

ingredients: Soft tofu, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, chili bean paste, vegetable oil, spring onion, sesame oil, cornstarch, water
instructions: Cut tofu into small cubes and set aside. Heat vegetable oil in a pan on medium heat. Add minced garlic and ginger and saut until fragrant. Add chili bean paste and stir for 30 seconds. Add tofu cubes gently, pour a little water, and simmer for 34 minutes. Mix cornstarch with water and add to pan to thicken sauce. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with chopped spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Carrot, cabbage, onion, garlic, ginger, spring onion, vegetable stock or water, salt, black pepper, sesame oil (optional)
instructions: Heat a pot with a little oil. Add minced garlic and ginger, saut briefly. Add chopped carrot, cabbage, and onion. Stir-fry for 23 minutes. Pour in vegetable stock or water. Bring to boil, then simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until vegetables are tender. Season with salt and black pepper. Drizzle sesame oil and garnish with spring onion. Serve hot.

ingredients: Tomato, carrot, beans, zucchini, pasta (small shapes), onion, garlic, olive oil, vegetable stock, salt, black pepper, oregano, basil
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until translucent. Add chopped carrot, beans, and zucchini, stir for 23 minutes. Add chopped tomato and cook until softened. Pour in vegetable stock and bring to a boil. Add pasta and cook until tender, stirring occasionally. Season with salt, black pepper, oregano, and basil. Serve hot.

ingredients: Pasta, fresh basil leaves, garlic, pine nuts, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, lemon juice (optional)
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain, and set aside. In a blender, combine basil leaves, garlic, pine nuts, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice (optional) to make pesto sauce. Toss cooked pasta with pesto sauce until evenly coated. Serve warm, garnished with extra parmesan.

ingredients: Chicken breast, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, olive oil, garlic, flour, egg, breadcrumbs, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs
instructions: Pound chicken breast to even thickness. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. Coat chicken with flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat with breadcrumbs. Heat olive oil in a pan and cook chicken until golden brown. Place cooked chicken in a baking dish, spread tomato sauce over it, sprinkle mozzarella and parmesan. Bake in preheated oven at 200C for 15 to 20 minutes until cheese melts. Serve hot.

ingredients: Arborio rice, mushrooms, onion, garlic, olive oil, vegetable stock, parmesan cheese, butter, salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release moisture. Add Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes. Gradually add warm vegetable stock, stirring continuously, letting rice absorb liquid before adding more. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes until rice is creamy and tender. Add parmesan cheese, salt, pepper, and garnish with parsley. Serve hot.

ingredients: Spaghetti pasta, garlic, olive oil, dried chili flakes, salt, black pepper, parsley (optional)
instructions: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente, drain, and reserve some pasta water. Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat. Sauteee sliced garlic until golden. Add chili flakes and cooked spaghetti. Toss quickly, adding a little reserved pasta water to coat evenly. Season with salt and black pepper. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: Noodles, chicken breast, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, oyster sauce, spring onion, carrot, cabbage, bell pepper, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Boil noodles until al dente, drain, and toss with a little oil to prevent sticking. Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, saut briefly. Add sliced chicken and stir-fry until fully cooked. Remove and set aside. Add sliced carrot, cabbage, and bell pepper to the wok. Stir-fry for 23 minutes until tender-crisp. Return cooked chicken to the wok. Add noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything on high heat for 23 minutes until well combined. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Cabbage, carrot, beans, spring onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, cornflour, vegetable stock, black pepper, oil, chili sauce (optional)
instructions: Finely chop all vegetables. Heat oil in a pot and saut minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add vegetables and stir-fry for 23 minutes. Pour in vegetable stock and bring to a boil. Mix cornflour with water and add to soup to thicken slightly. Season with soy sauce, black pepper, and chili sauce if using. Simmer for 5 minutes. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Bell peppers, cooked rice, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, onion, garlic, tomato, olive oil, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs (oregano, basil)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C. Cut the tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. Heat olive oil in a pan, saut chopped onion and garlic until translucent. Add diced tomato, cooked rice, salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. Mix well. Stuff the mixture into bell peppers, top with mozzarella and parmesan cheese. Place peppers in a baking dish and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until tender and cheese is melted. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken breast, garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, butter, flour, chicken stock, capers (optional), salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Pound chicken breast to even thickness and season with salt and pepper. Lightly coat chicken in flour. Heat olive oil and butter in a pan on medium heat. Pan-fry chicken until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and keep warm. In the same pan, saut minced garlic briefly. Add lemon juice, chicken stock, and capers. Simmer for 23 minutes. Return chicken to the pan and coat with sauce. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

ingredients: Cooked rice, carrot, peas, beans, bell pepper, garlic, spring onion, soy sauce, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and saut until fragrant. Add chopped carrot, peas, beans, and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 23 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Add cooked rice, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss well on high heat for 23 minutes. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Carrot, beans, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, spring onion, soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and ginger, saut briefly. Add chopped carrot, beans, and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 34 minutes until tender-crisp. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, salt, and black pepper in a small bowl. Pour sauce over vegetables and stir-fry for 2 more minutes until coated. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Ziti pasta, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, onion, garlic, olive oil, basil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C. Boil ziti pasta until al dente, drain and set aside. Heat olive oil in a pan. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until translucent. Add tomato sauce, salt, black pepper, and basil. Simmer for 57 minutes. Mix cooked pasta with sauce and half of the mozzarella cheese. Transfer to a baking dish, top with remaining mozzarella and parmesan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Lasagna sheets, chicken breast, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, onion, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs (oregano, basil)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C. Boil lasagna sheets as per instructions. Heat olive oil in a pan, saut chopped onion and garlic until soft. Add diced chicken, season with salt, black pepper, and Italian herbs, cook until done. Layer a baking dish with sauce, lasagna sheets, chicken mixture, and mozzarella cheese. Repeat layers and finish with parmesan on top. Bake for 3035 minutes until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Pasta, mushrooms, garlic, olive oil, parmesan cheese, butter, salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat olive oil and a small amount of butter in a pan. Sauteee minced garlic until fragrant. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender and slightly browned. Toss in cooked pasta, add salt, black pepper, and parmesan cheese. Mix well. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve warm.

ingredients: Tofu, mushrooms, carrot, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, cornflour, vegetable stock, sesame oil, salt, black pepper, spring onion
instructions: Heat vegetable stock in a pot. Add minced garlic and ginger, saut briefly. Add sliced mushrooms, carrot, and cabbage. Boil for 57 minutes until vegetables are tender. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, and cornflour slurry. Pour into soup, stirring to thicken. Add cubed tofu and simmer for 23 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with chopped spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken breast, mushrooms, carrot, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, cornflour, chicken stock, sesame oil, salt, black pepper, spring onion
instructions: Heat chicken stock in a pot and bring to a boil. Add minced garlic and ginger and saut briefly. Add sliced mushrooms, carrot, and cabbage. Boil until vegetables are tender. Mix soy sauce, vinegar, chili paste, and cornflour slurry. Pour into soup, stirring to thicken. Add shredded cooked chicken and simmer for 23 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper, drizzle sesame oil, garnish with chopped spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken pieces, tomato, onion, garlic, olive oil, carrots, celery, potatoes, chicken stock, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs (oregano, basil, thyme)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauteee chopped onion and garlic until translucent. Add chicken pieces and brown lightly on all sides. Add chopped tomato, carrots, celery, and potatoes. Pour in chicken stock. Season with salt, pepper, and Italian herbs. Simmer on low heat for 3040 minutes until chicken is tender and vegetables are cooked. Serve hot with bread or over rice.

ingredients: Cabbage, carrot, bell pepper, garlic, ginger, cooked noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, spring onion, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok. Sauteee minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add chopped cabbage, carrot, and bell pepper. Stir-fry for 34 minutes until tender-crisp. Add cooked noodles, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper. Toss well to combine. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot in a bowl.

ingredients: Pasta, garlic, lemon juice, lemon zest, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat olive oil in a pan, saut minced garlic until fragrant. Add cooked pasta, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Toss to combine. Season with salt and black pepper. Add parmesan cheese, mix well, and garnish with chopped parsley. Serve warm.

ingredients: Noodles, chicken breast, garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce, spring onion, vegetable oil, carrot, bell pepper, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat vegetable oil in a wok on high heat. Add minced garlic and saut briefly. Add sliced chicken and cook until done. Add julienned carrot and bell pepper, stir-fry for 23 minutes. Add noodles, soy sauce, oyster sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything well for 23 minutes. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Flatbread, bell pepper, zucchini, carrot, onion, spinach, mozzarella cheese, olive oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Slice all vegetables thinly. Heat olive oil in a pan and saut vegetables for 34 minutes until tender-crisp. Warm flatbread on a separate pan. Place sauted vegetables on the flatbread, sprinkle mozzarella cheese. Fold or roll tightly, press lightly, and grill for 23 minutes until flatbread is warm and cheese melts. Serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken breast, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, flour, egg, olive oil, salt, black pepper, lemon wedges
instructions: Pound chicken breast to even thickness. Season with salt and black pepper. Dredge chicken in flour, dip in beaten egg, and coat with breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan cheese. Heat olive oil in a pan on medium heat. Pan-fry chicken until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Serve hot with lemon wedges.

ingredients: Carrot, beans, bell pepper, broccoli, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, chili sauce, sesame oil, vegetable oil, spring onion, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok. Sauteee minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry on high heat for 34 minutes until tender-crisp. Add soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss well for 23 minutes. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Mushrooms, garlic, olive oil, butter, heavy cream, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, parsley
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan. Sauteee minced garlic until fragrant. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until tender and slightly browned. Pour in heavy cream and simmer for 34 minutes until slightly thickened. Add parmesan cheese, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and garnish with chopped parsley. Serve hot.

ingredients: Noodles, chicken breast, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, chili sauce, spring onion, vegetable oil, carrot, bell pepper, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cook noodles until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat vegetable oil in a wok on high heat. Sauteee minced garlic and ginger briefly. Add sliced chicken and cook until fully done. Add julienned carrot and bell pepper, stir-fry for 23 minutes. Add noodles, soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss well on high heat until noodles are coated and hot. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Vegetable dumplings, garlic, ginger, spring onion, soy sauce, vegetable stock, sesame oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat vegetable stock in a pot and bring to a boil. Add minced garlic and ginger, saut briefly. Add vegetable dumplings and simmer until dumplings are cooked through. Season with soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with chopped spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Bread slices, tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, basil leaves, salt, black pepper
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden brown. Finely chop tomatoes and garlic. Mix with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and chopped basil. Spread the tomato mixture evenly on toasted bread and serve fresh immediately.

ingredients: Bread slices, cooked chicken breast, tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, basil leaves, salt, black pepper
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden. Chop cooked chicken and tomatoes. Mix with minced garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and chopped basil. Top each toasted bread slice with the chicken-tomato mixture and serve warm.

ingredients: Cooked rice, garlic, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, spring onion
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a pan. Sauteee minced garlic until fragrant. Add cooked rice and toss well to combine. Season with salt and black pepper. Garnish with chopped spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Pasta, fresh spinach, garlic, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat olive oil in a pan, saut minced garlic until fragrant. Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted. Toss cooked pasta with spinach and garlic oil. Season with salt, black pepper, sprinkle parmesan cheese, and serve warm.

ingredients: Pasta, chicken breast, fresh spinach, garlic, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente, drain, and set aside. Heat olive oil in a pan, saut minced garlic. Add diced chicken and cook until fully done. Add fresh spinach and cook until wilted. Toss pasta with chicken and spinach. Season with salt and black pepper, sprinkle parmesan cheese, and serve hot.

ingredients: Cooked rice, carrot, beans, bell pepper, garlic, soy sauce, chili sauce, sesame oil, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok. Sauteee minced garlic until fragrant. Add chopped carrot, beans, and bell pepper, stir-fry on high heat for 34 minutes. Add cooked rice, soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything together on high heat for 23 minutes. Drizzle sesame oil and serve hot.

ingredients: Zucchini, bell pepper, carrot, broccoli, olive oil, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, Italian herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C. Chop all vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Toss vegetables with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and Italian herbs. Layer vegetables in a baking dish. Sprinkle mozzarella and parmesan cheese on top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until vegetables are tender and cheese is golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken breast, carrot, bell pepper, broccoli, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vegetable oil, salt, black pepper, spring onion
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a wok on high heat. Sauteee minced garlic and ginger until fragrant. Add diced chicken and cook until fully done. Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry for 34 minutes until tender-crisp. Add soy sauce, salt, and black pepper. Toss everything for 23 minutes. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Zucchini, bell pepper, mushrooms, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, rosemary, thyme
instructions: Preheat grill or oven to 200C. Slice zucchini, bell pepper, and mushrooms. Toss vegetables with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, rosemary, and thyme. Grill vegetables until tender and lightly charred, about 1015 minutes. Serve hot.

ingredients: Kidney beans, onion, tomato, ginger garlic paste, oil, cumin seeds, spices, salt
instructions: Soak kidney beans overnight and pressure cook until soft. Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds. Add onions and saut until golden. Add ginger garlic paste and cook briefly. Add tomato puree and spices. Cook until oil separates. Add cooked rajma and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot with rice.

ingredients: Basmati rice, carrot, beans, peas, onion, yogurt, spices, oil, mint, salt
instructions: Cook rice until 70% done and keep aside. Heat oil and saut onions until golden. Add vegetables and spices. Add yogurt and cook briefly. Layer rice and vegetable mixture. Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper
instructions: Marinate chicken with salt, pepper, olive oil, and lemon juice. Grill chicken until cooked and slice thinly. Chop vegetables and place in a bowl. Add grilled chicken on top. Toss lightly and serve fresh.

ingredients: Basmati rice, paneer, onion, peas, cumin seeds, oil, garam masala, salt
instructions: Heat oil and add cumin seeds. Add onions and saut until light brown. Add paneer cubes and peas and saut briefly. Add rice, garam masala, salt, and water. Cook covered on low heat until rice is fully cooked. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bell pepper, zucchini, carrot, peanuts, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, vinegar, oil, chili flakes
instructions: Heat oil in a wok on high heat. Add chopped garlic and ginger and saut quickly. Add chopped vegetables and stir fry for 34 minutes until slightly tender. Add peanuts, soy sauce, vinegar, and chili flakes. Stir fry on high heat until vegetables are well coated with sauce. Serve hot with steamed rice.

ingredients: Rice, chicken, bell pepper, onion, garlic, cumin powder, paprika, olive oil, salt
instructions: Cook rice and keep aside. Heat olive oil in a pan and saut garlic and onion. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned. Add bell pepper, cumin powder, paprika, and salt. Cook until chicken is tender and vegetables are soft. Serve chicken mixture over rice as a bowl meal.

ingredients: Falafel balls, rice, cucumber, tomato, yogurt, garlic, olive oil, salt
instructions: Cook rice and keep warm. Prepare or reheat falafel until crisp. Mix yogurt with garlic and salt to make sauce. Arrange rice on a plate, add falafel, chopped cucumber and tomato. Drizzle yogurt sauce and olive oil on top. Serve fresh.

ingredients: Fish fillet, zucchini, carrot, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt, pepper
instructions: Marinate fish with lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper for 15 minutes. Heat grill pan and brush with olive oil. Grill fish on both sides until cooked through. Grill vegetables separately until tender. Serve fish with grilled vegetables on the side.

ingredients: Rice, kidney beans, corn, bell pepper, onion, olive oil, cumin powder, salt
instructions: Cook rice and keep aside. Heat olive oil and saut onion and bell pepper. Add cooked beans, corn, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until well mixed. Serve vegetable mixture over rice in a bowl.

ingredients: Noodles, chicken, cabbage, carrot, garlic, soy sauce, oil, salt
instructions: Boil noodles and drain. Heat oil in a wok and saut garlic. Add chicken strips and cook until fully done. Add vegetables and stir fry on high heat. Add noodles, soy sauce, and salt. Toss well and serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, mushrooms, onion, garlic, butter, cream, salt, pepper
instructions: Cook rice and keep aside. Heat butter in a pan and saut garlic and onion. Add sliced mushrooms and cook until soft. Add cream, salt, and pepper and simmer for 5 minutes. Mix in cooked rice and heat through. Serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken thigh, rice, olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, onion, salt, black pepper
instructions: Cook rice separately and keep warm. Heat olive oil in a pan and saut chopped garlic and onion until soft. Add chicken pieces, rosemary, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Cook chicken on medium heat until golden and fully cooked. Serve herb chicken over rice for a filling lunch.

ingredients: Eggplant, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, chili paste, oil, sugar, spring onion
instructions: Cut eggplant into long strips. Heat oil in a wok and fry eggplant until soft. Remove and keep aside. In the same wok saut garlic and ginger. Add chili paste, soy sauce, and sugar. Add eggplant back and toss until coated. Garnish with spring onion and serve with rice.

ingredients: Quinoa, black beans, corn, bell pepper, onion, olive oil, cumin powder, salt
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions. Heat olive oil and saut onion and bell pepper. Add black beans, corn, cumin powder, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes. Serve vegetable mixture over quinoa for a healthy lunch bowl.

ingredients: Chicken, basmati rice, onion, garlic, cinnamon, cumin, olive oil, salt
instructions: Heat olive oil and saut onion and garlic. Add chicken and cook until lightly browned. Add spices, salt, rice, and water. Cover and cook until rice and chicken are fully cooked. Fluff gently and serve hot.

ingredients: Potato, carrot, beans, cream, garlic, olive oil, mixed herbs, salt, pepper
instructions: Slice vegetables thinly. Heat olive oil and saut garlic briefly. Layer vegetables in a baking dish, season with salt, pepper, and herbs. Pour cream over vegetables and bake at 180C for 35 minutes until soft and golden.

ingredients: Chicken breast, rice, soy sauce, honey, garlic, oil, sesame seeds
instructions: Cook rice and keep aside. Heat oil and cook chicken pieces until browned. Add garlic, soy sauce, and honey. Cook until sauce thickens and coats chicken. Serve over rice and garnish with sesame seeds.

ingredients: Pasta, spinach, ricotta cheese, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Boil pasta until al dente. Heat olive oil and saut garlic. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Add ricotta, salt, and pepper. Mix in pasta and toss well. Serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken, rice, chipotle sauce, onion, garlic, oil, salt
instructions: Cook rice and set aside. Heat oil and saut garlic and onion. Add chicken and cook until done. Add chipotle sauce and salt. Simmer briefly and serve chicken over rice.

ingredients: Freekeh wheat, onion, garlic, olive oil, carrot, cumin, salt
instructions: Heat olive oil and saut onion and garlic. Add carrot and cumin. Add freekeh and water. Cook until grains are tender and fluffy. Season with salt and serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken breast, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, herbs, salt, pepper
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon juice, garlic, herbs, salt, and pepper for 20 minutes. Grill or pan cook chicken until golden and cooked through. Serve with light salad or rice.

ingredients: Tofu, bell pepper, garlic, soy sauce, black pepper, oil
instructions: Pan fry tofu cubes until golden. Remove and keep aside. Sauteee garlic and bell pepper. Add soy sauce and black pepper. Add tofu back and toss well. Serve hot with rice.

ingredients: Polenta, mushroom, garlic, olive oil, parmesan cheese, salt
instructions: Cook polenta according to instructions. Heat olive oil and saut garlic and mushrooms. Season with salt. Serve mushrooms over creamy polenta and top with parmesan.

ingredients: Tortilla strips, beans, bell pepper, onion, tomato sauce, cheese
instructions: Cook beans and vegetables with tomato sauce until thick. Layer tortilla strips and vegetable mixture in a bowl. Top with cheese and bake until melted. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken thighs, onion, carrot, celery, garlic, tomato paste, olive oil, white wine, herbs, salt, pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy pan and sear chicken thighs until deeply browned on both sides. Remove and keep aside. In the same pan saut onion, carrot, celery, and garlic until soft. Add tomato paste and cook until darkened. Deglaze with white wine and reduce slightly. Return chicken to pan, add herbs, salt, pepper, and enough water to partially cover. Cover and slow cook on low heat for 4550 minutes until chicken is very tender and sauce thickens. Serve with rice or mashed vegetables.

ingredients: Firm tofu, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, five spice powder, sugar, oil, spring onion
instructions: Cut tofu into thick slices and pan fry in oil until golden on both sides. Remove and keep aside. In the same pan saut garlic and ginger until aromatic. Add soy sauce, sugar, five spice powder, and water to create braising liquid. Add tofu back and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes, turning occasionally. Finish with spring onion and serve with steamed rice.

ingredients: Chicken, dried chilies, cocoa powder, garlic, onion, tomato, oil, spices, rice
instructions: Soak dried chilies in hot water until soft and grind with garlic, onion, tomato, and spices. Heat oil and cook chicken pieces until lightly browned. Remove and keep aside. Add mole sauce paste to the pan and cook slowly until thick and glossy. Return chicken to sauce and simmer on low heat for 30 minutes. Serve rich mole chicken over cooked rice.

recipe_name: Middle Eastern Lamb and Rice Pilaf
ingredients: Lamb pieces, basmati rice, onion, garlic, cinnamon, cardamom, olive oil, salt
instructions: Heat olive oil and brown lamb pieces thoroughly. Remove and keep aside. In the same pot saut onion and garlic until golden. Add spices and rice and stir briefly. Return lamb to pot, add water, cover, and cook slowly until rice is fluffy and lamb is tender. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

ingredients: Chicken breast, spinach, cheese, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Butterfly chicken breasts and flatten evenly. Prepare filling by sauting garlic and spinach until wilted, then cool and mix with cheese. Spread filling over chicken, roll tightly, and secure with thread. Sear roulades in olive oil, then finish cooking in oven at 180C for 25 minutes. Slice carefully and serve hot.

ingredients: Arborio rice, shrimp, squid, onion, garlic, olive oil, parmesan cheese, stock
instructions: Heat olive oil and saut onion and garlic until soft. Add rice and toast lightly. Gradually add hot stock while stirring continuously. Halfway through cooking add seafood and continue adding stock until rice is creamy and cooked. Finish with parmesan cheese and rest for 5 minutes before serving.

ingredients: Chicken, rice, soy sauce, ginger, garlic, sesame oil, spring onion
instructions: Marinate chicken with soy sauce, ginger, and garlic. Cook rice partially in a clay pot. Arrange marinated chicken on top of rice. Cover and cook on very low heat until rice absorbs chicken juices and forms crispy bottom. Drizzle sesame oil, garnish with spring onion, and serve hot.

ingredients: Flattened rice, potato, onion, green chili, ginger, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Wash flattened rice and squeeze excess water. Mix with boiled mashed potato, chopped onion, green chili, ginger, salt, and spices. Shape into small patties. Heat oil in a pan and shallow fry until golden brown on both sides. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Sweet corn, onion, tomato, lemon juice, chaat masala, salt, butter
instructions: Boil sweet corn until tender and drain. Heat butter in a pan and saut corn for 2 minutes. Add chopped onion, tomato, salt, and chaat masala. Mix well, finish with lemon juice, and serve warm.

ingredients: Bread, paneer, onion, green chili, butter, salt, pepper
instructions: Grate paneer and mix with chopped onion, green chili, salt, and pepper. Butter bread slices and spread paneer mixture evenly. Toast on a pan or grill until bread is crisp and filling is heated. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flour, potato, peas, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Prepare dough using flour, oil, salt, and water and rest it. Cook potato and peas with spices to make filling. Roll dough, fill with mixture, shape samosas, and deep fry in medium-hot oil until crisp. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Paneer, gram flour, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Prepare thick batter using gram flour, spices, salt, and water. Dip paneer slices into batter. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crisp. Drain excess oil and serve hot.

ingredients: Potato, spices, yogurt, tamarind chutney, oil, salt
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes with spices and salt. Shape into patties. Shallow fry until crisp. Top with yogurt and tamarind chutney. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Bread, chicken mince, onion, garlic, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Cook chicken mince with onion, garlic, and spices until dry. Flatten bread slices, fill with chicken mixture, roll tightly. Shallow fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flour, lentils, spices, yogurt, chutneys, oil, salt
instructions: Prepare lentil filling with spices. Make dough, stuff with filling, and deep fry until crisp. Crush kachoris slightly and top with yogurt and chutneys. Serve fresh.

ingredients: Chicken mince, onion, garlic, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Mix chicken mince with onion, garlic, spices, and salt. Shape onto skewers. Grill or pan cook with oil until evenly cooked and slightly charred. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flour, cabbage, carrot, garlic, oil, salt
instructions: Prepare dough with flour and water. Cook vegetable filling lightly with garlic and salt. Fill dough wrappers, shape momos, and steam until cooked. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Flour, chicken mince, garlic, onion, oil, salt
instructions: Prepare dough and chicken filling. Fill wrappers and shape momos carefully. Steam for 1215 minutes until cooked through. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flour, paneer, onion, spices, butter, salt
instructions: Prepare soft dough and paneer stuffing with spices. Stuff dough balls and roll gently. Cook on tawa with butter until golden spots appear. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken mince, cheese, bread crumbs, spices, oil, salt
instructions: Mix chicken mince with spices and salt. Stuff cheese cubes inside mixture and shape balls. Roll in breadcrumbs and deep fry until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Vegetable cutlet, roti, onion, chutney, oil
instructions: Prepare vegetable cutlets and keep ready. Heat roti lightly on pan. Place cutlet, onion, and chutney on roti. Roll tightly and serve warm.

ingredients: Puff pastry sheets, chicken, onion, spices, butter, salt
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and spices until dry. Fill pastry sheets with mixture and seal edges. Bake at 180C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Cabbage, carrot, flour, garlic, soy sauce, oil, salt
instructions: Finely chop cabbage and carrot and squeeze out excess water. Mix with flour, salt, and garlic to form a soft mixture. Shape into small balls and deep fry in medium-hot oil until golden and crisp. Serve hot with soy or chili sauce.

ingredients: Bread, cooked chicken, garlic, soy sauce, oil, pepper
instructions: Finely chop cooked chicken and saut with garlic and soy sauce. Spread mixture evenly on bread slices. Toast on pan or oven until bread is crisp and topping is heated. Cut into pieces and serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, garlic, butter, cheese, herbs
instructions: Mix softened butter with garlic and herbs. Spread mixture on bread slices and top with grated cheese. Bake or toast until cheese melts and bread turns crisp. Serve warm.

ingredients: Bread, zucchini, bell pepper, cheese, olive oil, salt
instructions: Grill sliced vegetables with olive oil and salt. Place vegetables and cheese between bread slices. Grill or toast until bread is crisp and cheese melts. Serve warm.

ingredients: Tortilla, cheese, onion, capsicum, oil, salt
instructions: Sauteee onion and capsicum lightly with oil and salt. Spread vegetables and cheese on tortilla. Fold and cook on pan until golden and cheese melts. Cut and serve hot.

ingredients: Nachos, cooked chicken, cheese, jalapeno
instructions: Spread nachos on a baking tray. Top with shredded chicken and cheese. Bake until cheese melts completely. Add jalapenos and serve immediately.

ingredients: Potato, cheese, bread crumbs, oil, salt
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes with salt and cheese. Shape into small cylinders and coat with breadcrumbs. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken sausage, oil, herbs
instructions: Slice chicken sausages into bite-sized pieces. Pan fry with oil and herbs until lightly crisp. Serve hot with dip.

ingredients: Chickpeas, garlic, parsley, flour, oil, salt
instructions: Blend soaked chickpeas with garlic, parsley, salt, and flour. Shape into small balls. Deep fry until crisp and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, flatbread, garlic sauce, oil, spices
instructions: Cook chicken with oil and spices until tender. Wrap chicken in flatbread with garlic sauce. Cut into small pieces and serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken breast, cornflour, garlic, dry red chilli, honey, soy sauce, oil, salt
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Marinate with salt and cornflour. Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crisp and golden. Drain excess oil. In a pan, heat oil and saut garlic and dry red chilli until aromatic. Add soy sauce and honey, mix well. Toss fried chicken into the sauce. Cook on medium heat until evenly coated and glossy. Serve hot.

ingredients: Spring roll sheets, cabbage, carrot, garlic, soy sauce, oil
instructions: Finely shred cabbage and carrot. Stir fry with garlic and soy sauce. Allow filling to cool completely. Place filling on spring roll sheets, roll tightly, and seal edges. Deep fry on medium heat until crisp and golden brown. Serve hot with chili dip.

ingredients: Cooked rice, cheese, breadcrumbs, olive oil, garlic, herbs
instructions: Mix cooked rice with garlic, herbs, and grated cheese. Shape mixture into small balls with cheese in the center. Roll balls in breadcrumbs evenly. Deep fry until golden and crisp. Drain excess oil and serve warm.

ingredients: Bread slices, cooked chicken, cheese, garlic, olive oil
instructions: Toast bread slices lightly with olive oil. Mix shredded chicken with garlic and cheese. Spread mixture on toasted bread. Bake until topping is heated and cheese melts. Serve warm as finger food.

ingredients: Nachos, kidney beans, onion, cheese, jalapeno
instructions: Cook kidney beans with salt until soft and lightly mashed. Spread nachos on a baking tray. Top with beans, onion, jalapenos, and cheese. Bake until cheese melts and bubbles. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Tortilla, cooked chicken, cheese, oil, spices
instructions: Mix shredded chicken with spices and cheese. Fill tortillas with mixture and roll tightly. Secure with toothpicks if needed. Deep fry until crisp and golden. Serve hot with dip.

ingredients: Potatoes, cheese, butter, salt, pepper
instructions: Boil potatoes and cut in half. Scoop out center carefully. Fill potato skins with cheese, butter, salt, and pepper. Bake until cheese melts and skins are crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, flour, spices, oil
instructions: Cut chicken into small cubes. Coat with flour and spices evenly. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and cooked through. Drain excess oil and serve hot.

ingredients: Falafel balls, pita bread, lettuce, tahini sauce
instructions: Warm pita bread and cut open to form pockets. Place falafel balls inside with lettuce. Drizzle with tahini sauce evenly. Serve warm.

ingredients: Minced chicken, bulgur wheat, spices, oil
instructions: Soak bulgur wheat and drain excess water. Mix with minced chicken and spices thoroughly. Shape into oval croquettes. Deep fry until crisp and cooked inside. Serve hot.

ingredients: Pastry sheets, spinach, cheese, olive oil
instructions: Cook spinach lightly and remove excess moisture. Mix with cheese and seasoning. Fill pastry sheets, roll tightly, and seal edges. Bake until golden and crisp. Serve warm.

ingredients: Mushrooms, garlic, soy sauce, cheese
instructions: Remove stems from mushrooms and chop finely. Sauteee chopped stems with garlic and soy sauce. Stuff mixture into mushroom caps and top with cheese. Bake until mushrooms are tender and cheese melts. Serve hot.

ingredients: Lotus stem, cornflour, garlic, dry red chilli, soy sauce, vinegar, oil, salt
instructions: Slice lotus stem thinly and soak in water. Drain and coat with cornflour and salt. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. Remove and drain excess oil. Heat oil in a pan, saut garlic and dry red chilli until fragrant. Add soy sauce and vinegar, mix well. Toss fried lotus stem until evenly coated. Serve hot as a crunchy snack.

ingredients: Minced chicken, chives, flour, garlic, soy sauce, oil
instructions: Mix minced chicken with chopped chives, garlic, and soy sauce. Prepare soft dough using flour and water. Roll dough into small discs. Place filling inside, seal, and flatten gently. Pan-fry pancakes on medium heat until golden and cooked through. Serve hot with dipping sauce.

ingredients: Polenta, cheese, butter, herbs, olive oil
instructions: Cook polenta until thick and smooth. Mix in butter, herbs, and grated cheese. Spread mixture into a tray and allow to set completely. Cut into bite-sized squares. Pan-fry or bake until crisp on the outside. Serve warm.

ingredients: Cooked chicken, mozzarella, breadcrumbs, egg, olive oil
instructions: Combine shredded chicken with mozzarella and egg. Shape mixture into small patties. Coat evenly with breadcrumbs. Shallow fry until golden and crisp on both sides. Serve hot.

ingredients: Flour, corn kernels, cheese, butter, spices, oil
instructions: Prepare dough using flour and butter. Rest dough for 20 minutes. Mix corn, cheese, and spices for filling. Roll dough, fill, fold, and seal edges. Deep fry until golden and crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla, chicken, cheese, onion, oil
instructions: Cook chicken with onion until tender. Spread chicken and cheese on tortilla. Fold and cook on pan until crisp and cheese melts. Cut into bite-sized pieces and serve hot.

ingredients: Mushrooms, potato, breadcrumbs, butter, herbs, oil
instructions: Cook mushrooms and mash with boiled potato and herbs. Shape mixture into cylinders. Coat with breadcrumbs. Deep fry until crisp and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Puff pastry, chicken, onion, butter, herbs
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and herbs until tender. Cut puff pastry into squares. Fill with chicken mixture and seal edges. Bake until pastry is golden and flaky. Serve warm.

ingredients: Flour, cheese, butter, milk, oil
instructions: Prepare soft dough using flour, butter, and milk. Fill with cheese mixture and seal into crescents. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

ingredients: Chicken, pita bread, garlic, spices, oil
instructions: Marinate chicken with garlic and spices. Cook on pan until tender and lightly charred. Fill warm pita bread with chicken. Serve hot.

ingredients: Zucchini, ricotta cheese, flour, egg, olive oil
instructions: Grate zucchini and squeeze excess water. Mix with ricotta, egg, and flour. Pan-fry spoonfuls until golden. Serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken, bell pepper, garlic, soy sauce, oil
instructions: Marinate chicken with garlic and soy sauce. Skewer chicken with bell peppers. Grill or pan fry until cooked and lightly charred. Serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla, spinach, cheese, oil
instructions: Cook spinach and mix with cheese. Fill tortillas and roll tightly. Deep fry until crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Mixed vegetables, potato, breadcrumbs, herbs
instructions: Mix mashed potato with cooked vegetables and herbs. Shape into patties and coat with breadcrumbs. Bake until golden on both sides. Serve warm.

ingredients: Chicken, spices, garlic, olive oil
instructions: Marinate chicken with spices, garlic, and olive oil. Pan fry on medium heat until cooked and lightly crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, tomato, basil, olive oil, garlic
instructions: Cut bread into rounds and toast until crisp. Mix chopped tomato with basil and garlic. Spoon mixture onto bread cups. Serve fresh.

ingredients: Mixed vegetables, flour, sesame seeds, oil
instructions: Mix vegetables with flour and seasoning. Shape into fingers and coat with sesame seeds. Deep fry until crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Jalapenos, cheese, breadcrumbs, oil
instructions: Slit jalapenos and remove seeds. Fill with cheese and coat with breadcrumbs. Deep fry until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, chicken, cream, butter
instructions: Cook chicken in butter and cream until thick. Spread mixture on bread slices. Toast until golden. Serve warm.

ingredients: Cheese, herbs, flour, oil
instructions: Mix cheese with herbs and flour. Shape into small balls. Deep fry until golden brown. Serve hot.

ingredients: Oats, onion, carrot, peas, mustard seeds, curry leaves, oil, salt
instructions: Dry roast oats lightly and keep aside. Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add chopped onion and saut until soft. Add carrot and peas and cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Add water and salt and bring to a boil. Add roasted oats slowly while stirring continuously. Cook on low heat until mixture thickens. Serve hot.

ingredients: Gram flour, onion, tomato, green chilli, turmeric, oil, salt
instructions: Mix gram flour with water, turmeric, and salt to form a smooth batter. Add finely chopped onion, tomato, and green chilli. Heat a pan, pour batter, spread gently, drizzle oil, and cook until golden on both sides. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Flattened rice, onion, potato, peanuts, mustard seeds, oil, turmeric, salt
instructions: Wash poha and drain excess water. Heat oil and add mustard seeds and peanuts. Add onion and potato and cook until soft. Add turmeric and salt. Add poha and mix gently. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes. Serve hot.

ingredients: Vermicelli, onion, carrot, beans, mustard seeds, oil, salt
instructions: Dry roast vermicelli until light golden. Heat oil and add mustard seeds. Add onion and vegetables and saut briefly. Add water and salt and bring to boil. Add vermicelli and cook until soft. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, paneer, onion, green chilli, butter, spices
instructions: Mix grated paneer with onion, green chilli, and spices. Spread mixture on buttered bread slices. Toast on pan until crisp and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, lentils, potato, onion, spices, oil
instructions: Prepare fermented dosa batter. Cook potato with onion and spices to make masala. Spread batter on hot tawa, drizzle oil, place masala, fold, and cook until crisp. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Wheat flour, paneer, spices, oil
instructions: Prepare soft dough. Mix grated paneer with spices. Stuff filling inside dough balls, roll gently, and cook on tawa until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, lentils, onion, tomato, oil
instructions: Pour thick batter on hot pan. Sprinkle chopped vegetables on top. Cook covered until base turns golden. Flip gently and cook briefly. Serve hot.

recipe_name: Moong Dal Chilla Stuffed with Paneer
ingredients: Moong dal, paneer, spices, oil
instructions: Soak moong dal and grind to smooth batter. Make chilla on pan. Add paneer filling, fold, and cook until crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Semolina, curd, vegetables, fruit salt, oil
instructions: Mix semolina, curd, vegetables, and salt. Rest batter briefly. Add fruit salt and steam idlis until cooked. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, lentils, potato, red chutney, oil
instructions: Prepare dosa batter and spicy red chutney. Spread chutney on dosa, add potato masala, and cook until crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, lentils, mixed vegetables, spices, oil
instructions: Prepare fermented batter with vegetables and spices. Cook slowly in pan or bake until crust forms. Serve warm.

ingredients: Wheat flour, fenugreek leaves, spices, oil
instructions: Knead dough with methi leaves and spices. Roll thin theplas. Cook on tawa with oil until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice flour, vegetables, spices
instructions: Prepare idiyappam dough and steam noodles. Prepare vegetable filling separately. Stuff and steam lightly again. Serve hot.

ingredients: Green gram, onion, ginger, oil
instructions: Soak green gram and grind with ginger. Spread batter on tawa, add onion topping, drizzle oil, and cook until crisp. Serve hot.
