ingredients: Rice, curd, carrot, oil, mustard seeds
instructions: Cook rice and cool slightly. Mix with curd and salt. Prepare tempering with mustard seeds and oil. Add vegetables and mix. Serve chilled or warm.

ingredients: Semolina, curd, vegetables, bread, oil
instructions: Prepare thick rava batter with vegetables. Spread on bread slices and toast until crisp. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, paneer, onion, spices, butter
instructions: Cook paneer with onion and spices. Fill mixture between buttered bread slices and toast. Serve hot.

ingredients: Semolina, vegetables, spices, ghee
instructions: Roast semolina in ghee. Cook vegetables with spices. Add water and bring to boil. Add semolina and cook until thick. Serve hot.

ingredients: All-purpose flour, cabbage, carrot, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, oil, yeast, salt
instructions: Prepare soft dough using flour, yeast, water, and salt and rest until doubled. Finely chop cabbage, carrot, spring onion, and garlic. Sauteee vegetables lightly with oil and soy sauce until moisture evaporates. Cool completely. Divide dough, stuff filling, seal properly, and rest for 10 minutes. Steam buns for 1215 minutes until fluffy. Serve hot.

ingredients: Rice, carrot, mushroom, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt
instructions: Wash rice and cook with excess water until grains break down completely. Add finely chopped carrot, mushroom, and grated ginger. Simmer slowly until thick and porridge-like. Season with salt, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Serve hot.

ingredients: All-purpose flour, spring onion, oil, salt
instructions: Knead soft dough using flour and water. Roll thin and brush with oil. Sprinkle chopped spring onions and salt. Roll, coil, flatten, and pan-fry until crisp. Cook on medium heat until golden on both sides. Serve hot.

ingredients: Eggs, zucchini, bell pepper, onion, olive oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Sauteee chopped vegetables in olive oil until soft. Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Pour eggs over vegetables and cook on low heat until set. Flip carefully or finish in oven. Serve warm.

ingredients: Bread, ricotta cheese, olive oil, basil, salt, pepper
instructions: Toast bread slices until crisp. Spread ricotta generously. Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle chopped basil, salt, and pepper. Serve fresh.

ingredients: Polenta, milk, zucchini, mushroom, olive oil, salt
instructions: Cook polenta slowly in salted milk until creamy. Sauteee vegetables in olive oil until lightly browned. Top creamy polenta with vegetables and serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla, beans, bell pepper, onion, cheese, cumin, oil
instructions: Sauteee onion and bell pepper with cumin. Add cooked beans and mash lightly. Warm tortilla, add filling, sprinkle cheese, roll tightly. Toast lightly on pan and serve hot.

ingredients: Eggs, tomato, onion, chilli, oil, salt
instructions: Sauteee onion, tomato, and chilli in oil. Add beaten eggs and scramble gently until just cooked. Season with salt and serve hot.

ingredients: Tortilla chips, tomatillo sauce, cheese, onion, oil
instructions: Heat green sauce in pan. Add tortilla chips and toss gently. Top with cheese and onion. Cook briefly until chips soften slightly. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Eggs, tomato, bell pepper, onion, olive oil, cumin
instructions: Cook onion and bell pepper in olive oil. Add tomato puree and spices. Simmer until thick. Make wells and crack eggs. Cover and cook until eggs are just set. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, labneh, olive oil, zaatar
instructions: Toast bread slices. Spread labneh evenly. Drizzle olive oil and sprinkle zaatar. Serve fresh.

ingredients: Chickpeas, herbs, garlic, olive oil, spices
instructions: Grind soaked chickpeas with herbs and spices. Shape into balls and fry until crisp. Serve with salad and hummus.

ingredients: Eggs, onion, bell pepper, butter, salt, pepper
instructions: Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Sauteee vegetables in butter. Pour eggs and cook gently. Fold and serve hot.

ingredients: Beans, tomato sauce, garlic, olive oil
instructions: Sauteee garlic in olive oil. Add beans and tomato sauce. Simmer gently and bake briefly until thick. Serve hot.

ingredients: Croissant, bell pepper, cheese, butter
instructions: Slice croissant and lightly toast. Sauteee vegetables in butter. Fill croissant with vegetables and cheese. Bake briefly until cheese melts. Serve warm.

recipe_name: Chinese Egg Drop Soup with Vegetables
ingredients: Eggs, carrot, spring onion, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, water, salt
instructions: Bring water to a gentle boil and add minced garlic and chopped carrot. Simmer until vegetables soften. Lower heat and slowly drizzle beaten eggs while stirring gently. Season with soy sauce, salt, and sesame oil. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

recipe_name: Chinese Vegetable Fried Rice Breakfast Bowl
ingredients: Cooked rice, carrot, beans, spring onion, garlic, oil, soy sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a wok and saut garlic until aromatic. Add chopped vegetables and stir-fry on high heat until crisp-tender. Add rice and soy sauce, tossing continuously to avoid clumping. Garnish with spring onion and serve hot.

ingredients: Eggs, spinach, ricotta cheese, olive oil, salt, black pepper
instructions: Sauteee spinach in olive oil until wilted. Beat eggs with salt and pepper. Pour eggs into pan, add ricotta, and cook on low heat until set. Fold gently and serve warm.

ingredients: Pastry base, zucchini, onion, cheese, olive oil, salt
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C. Sauteee zucchini and onion until soft. Arrange vegetables over pastry base, sprinkle cheese and salt. Bake until crust is golden and filling is set. Cool slightly before serving.

ingredients: Tortilla, cheese, bell pepper, onion, oil
instructions: Sauteee bell pepper and onion lightly. Place filling and cheese between tortillas. Cook on hot pan until tortillas crisp and cheese melts. Cut and serve hot.

ingredients: Eggs, tortilla, tomato sauce, onion, oil
instructions: Heat tomato sauce with sauted onion. Fry eggs separately until sunny-side up. Warm tortillas and place eggs on top. Spoon hot sauce over eggs and serve immediately.

ingredients: Chickpeas, onion, garlic, olive oil, cumin, paprika
instructions: Sauteee onion and garlic in olive oil. Add chickpeas and spices. Cook until chickpeas are lightly crisped. Serve hot with bread.

ingredients: Eggplant, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, salt
instructions: Roast eggplant until soft. Scoop flesh and mash with garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt. Serve warm with flatbread.

ingredients: Flatbread dough, spinach, cheese, olive oil
instructions: Prepare dough and rest. Stuff with spinach and cheese. Roll gently and cook on hot pan until golden on both sides. Serve warm.

ingredients: Potato, carrot, onion, olive oil, salt, pepper
instructions: Dice vegetables and toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake at 200C until crisp and golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Bread, mushroom, cream, butter, garlic
instructions: Sauteee mushrooms and garlic in butter. Add cream and simmer gently. Spoon over toasted bread and serve warm.

ingredients: Bread, milk, egg, cheese, vegetables
instructions: Layer bread and vegetables in baking dish. Whisk eggs and milk and pour over. Top with cheese and bake until set and golden.

ingredients: Bread, avocado, olive oil, lemon juice, salt
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread over toasted bread. Drizzle olive oil and serve fresh.

ingredients: Tortilla, scrambled eggs, vegetables, cheese
instructions: Scramble eggs lightly. Sauteee vegetables. Fill tortilla with eggs, vegetables, and cheese. Roll and toast lightly.

ingredients: Potato, butter, salt, pepper
instructions: Grate potatoes and squeeze excess moisture. Season and pan-fry in butter until crisp and golden on both sides. Serve hot.

ingredients: Semolina, curd, onion, tomato, green chili, ginger, oil, salt
instructions: Mix semolina, curd, salt, and water to form a thick batter and rest for 15 minutes. Heat a pan and grease lightly with oil. Pour batter and spread gently. Top with chopped onion, tomato, green chili, and ginger. Cook on medium heat until base is golden, flip and cook other side. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Flattened rice, potato, onion, green peas, spices, oil
instructions: Soak poha briefly and drain. Mash boiled potato and peas. Mix poha with vegetables, spices, and salt. Shape into cutlets. Shallow fry on medium heat until crisp and golden on both sides. Serve hot.

ingredients: Wheat flour, potato, carrot, spices, oil
instructions: Prepare dough using wheat flour and water. Mix grated vegetables with spices to make stuffing. Stuff dough balls, roll gently, and cook on hot tawa using oil until golden. Serve hot with curd.

ingredients: Rice, moong dal, carrot, pepper, cumin, ghee
instructions: Dry roast rice and dal lightly. Cook with vegetables and water until soft. Temper ghee with cumin and crushed pepper and mix into pongal. Cook until creamy and serve hot.

ingredients: Paneer, onion, tomato, bread, butter, spices
instructions: Sauteee onion and tomato with spices. Add crumbled paneer and cook briefly. Spread mixture over toasted bread with butter and serve hot.

ingredients: Millet batter, carrot, onion, oil
instructions: Prepare fermented millet batter. Heat tawa and pour batter thinly. Sprinkle chopped vegetables and drizzle oil. Cook until crisp and golden. Serve hot with chutney.

ingredients: Boiled chickpeas, onion, garlic, spices, oil
instructions: Heat oil and saut garlic and onion. Add chickpeas and spices. Cook on medium heat until slightly crisp. Serve hot with lemon wedges.

ingredients: Wheat flour, fenugreek leaves, spices, oil
instructions: Mix flour, chopped fenugreek, spices, and oil to form soft dough. Roll thin and cook on tawa with oil until golden spots appear. Serve warm.

ingredients: Moong dal, paneer, onion, spices, oil
instructions: Soak and grind moong dal into batter. Prepare paneer-onion stuffing. Spread batter on pan, add stuffing, cover with batter, and cook until golden. Serve hot.

ingredients: Basmati rice, milk, sugar, cardamom, cashews, raisins, ghee
instructions: Wash and soak rice for 20 minutes. Boil milk in a heavy-bottom pan and add drained rice. Cook on low heat, stirring frequently, until rice is soft and milk thickens. Add sugar and cardamom powder and mix well. Fry cashews and raisins in ghee and add to kheer. Simmer for 5 minutes and serve warm or chilled.

ingredients: Semolina, ghee, sugar, water, cardamom, cashews
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and roast semolina on low heat until aromatic and lightly golden. Boil water separately and carefully add to roasted semolina while stirring. Add sugar and cardamom and cook until mixture thickens. Garnish with fried cashews and serve hot.

ingredients: Desiccated coconut, condensed milk, cardamom, ghee
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add desiccated coconut. Roast lightly on low heat. Add condensed milk and cardamom and cook until mixture thickens. Cool slightly, shape into small ladoos, and serve.

ingredients: Carrot, milk, sugar, ghee, cardamom, cashews
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and saut grated carrot until soft. Add milk and cook on medium heat until milk reduces completely. Add sugar and cardamom and cook until halwa thickens. Garnish with fried cashews and serve warm.

ingredients: Gram flour, ghee, powdered sugar, cardamom
instructions: Heat ghee and roast gram flour on very low heat until deep golden and aromatic. Allow to cool slightly, then add powdered sugar and cardamom. Mix well and shape into ladoos while warm.

ingredients: Thick curd, powdered sugar, cardamom, saffron
instructions: Tie curd in muslin cloth and hang for 6 hours to remove whey. Whisk thickened curd with powdered sugar until smooth. Add cardamom and soaked saffron. Chill and serve.

ingredients: Gram flour, ghee, sugar, water
instructions: Prepare sugar syrup to one-string consistency. Mix gram flour with melted ghee and add gradually to syrup while stirring. Cook on low heat until mixture thickens and leaves sides. Pour into greased tray, cool slightly, cut, and serve.

ingredients: Milk, lemon juice, sugar, cardamom, saffron
instructions: Boil milk and curdle using lemon juice. Strain and knead chenna until smooth. Shape into discs and cook in sugar syrup. Prepare thickened saffron milk and soak cooked discs. Chill and serve.

ingredients: Flour, milk, sugar, fennel seeds, ghee
instructions: Prepare batter using flour, milk, sugar, and fennel seeds. Rest for 30 minutes. Heat ghee and pour batter to form pancakes. Fry until golden and crisp. Serve warm.

ingredients: Paneer, powdered sugar, cardamom
instructions: Knead paneer until smooth. Mix powdered sugar and cardamom. Shape into discs and bake at 180C for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly set. Cool and serve.

ingredients: Flour, water, butter, sugar, cinnamon, oil
instructions: Heat water, butter, and sugar in a saucepan until butter melts and mixture boils. Reduce heat and add flour at once, stirring continuously until a smooth dough forms and leaves the sides of the pan. Remove from heat and let dough cool for 5 minutes. Transfer to piping bag with star nozzle. Heat oil to 180C. Pipe strips of dough directly into hot oil. Fry until golden brown and crisp, about 34 minutes. Drain excess oil. Roll churros in cinnamon sugar and serve warm.

ingredients: Cream cheese, biscuit base, butter, sugar, egg, vanilla
instructions: Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press firmly into a springform pan. Chill for 20 minutes. Beat cream cheese until smooth. Add sugar and vanilla and mix well. Add eggs one at a time, mixing gently to avoid air bubbles. Pour filling over base. Bake at 160C for 55 to 60 minutes until edges are set and center slightly jiggles. Turn off oven, leave door slightly open, and cool cheesecake inside. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before slicing.

ingredients: Flour, milk, egg, butter, sugar, baking powder
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl. Add milk, eggs, and melted butter. Mix until smooth batter forms. Let batter rest for 10 minutes for better texture. Preheat waffle iron and lightly grease it. Pour batter and cook until waffles are golden and crisp. Serve immediately with syrup, butter, or fruits.

ingredients: Dark chocolate, butter, sugar, flour, eggs
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together using a double boiler or microwave. Whisk sugar into the warm mixture until glossy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition. Fold in flour gently without overmixing. Pour batter into lined baking tray. Bake at 170C for 25 to 30 minutes until edges are set and center is fudgy.

ingredients: Mascarpone, coffee, biscuits, cocoa powder, sugar
instructions: Brew strong coffee and let it cool completely. Whisk mascarpone with sugar until smooth and creamy. Dip biscuits briefly into coffee without soaking. Layer dipped biscuits and mascarpone cream in serving cups. Repeat layers and finish with cream. Dust with cocoa powder and chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

ingredients: Dark chocolate, butter, sugar, egg, flour
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter together until smooth. Whisk sugar and eggs until slightly thickened. Combine chocolate mixture with eggs and mix gently. Fold in flour until just incorporated. Pour batter into greased ramekins. Bake at 200C for 10 to 12 minutes until edges are firm and center remains molten.

ingredients: Flour, cocoa powder, butter, sugar, egg, cream cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 180C and line cupcake tray. Mix flour and cocoa powder in a bowl. Cream butter and sugar until light, then add eggs. Add dry ingredients and red coloring, mixing gently. Bake cupcakes for 18 to 20 minutes and cool completely. Frost with cream cheese frosting and serve.

ingredients: Yogurt, honey, granola, mixed fruits
instructions: Chop fruits into small bite-sized pieces. Sweeten yogurt with honey and mix well. Add a layer of yogurt to serving glass. Add granola followed by fruits. Repeat layers until glass is full. Serve chilled for best taste.

ingredients: Dark chocolate, cream, cocoa powder
instructions: Heat cream until just beginning to simmer. Pour hot cream over chopped chocolate. Let sit for 2 minutes, then stir until smooth ganache forms. Refrigerate mixture until firm enough to scoop. Roll into small balls using palms. Coat with cocoa powder and chill again before serving.

ingredients: Banana, cream, caramel, biscuit base, butter
instructions: Prepare biscuit base and press into pie dish. Chill until firm. Spread thick layer of caramel evenly over base. Slice bananas and arrange over caramel. Whip cream until soft peaks form. Spread cream on top evenly. Chill for 1 hour before slicing.

ingredients: Flour, milk, egg, sugar, butter, maple syrup
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, milk, and eggs to form smooth batter. Heat pan and lightly grease with butter. Pour batter and cook until bubbles appear on surface. Flip and cook until golden brown. tack pancakes neatly. Drizzle maple syrup and serve warm.

ingredients: Cream cheese, Oreo biscuits, butter, sugar
instructions: Crush Oreo biscuits and mix with melted butter. Press into pan. Chill. Beat cream cheese with sugar until smooth. Fold in crushed Oreos gently. Spread mixture over base evenly. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours until set. Slice and serve chilled.

ingredients: Apple, flour, butter, sugar, cinnamon
instructions: Peel and slice apples. Cook with sugar and cinnamon until soft. Transfer apples to baking dish. Mix flour, butter, and sugar to form crumbly topping. Spread crumble evenly over apples. Bake at 180C for 35 to 40 minutes until golden. Serve warm.

ingredients: Dark chocolate, cream, sugar
instructions: Melt chocolate and allow to cool slightly. Whip cream with sugar until soft peaks form. Fold melted chocolate gently into whipped cream. Spoon into serving bowls. Chill for at least 2 hours. Serve cold.

ingredients: Flour, milk, egg, Nutella, butter
instructions: Whisk flour, milk, and eggs to form thin batter. Heat pan and lightly grease with butter. Pour batter and spread thinly. Cook briefly on both sides. Spread Nutella on warm crepe. Fold or roll crepe neatly. Serve warm with powdered sugar.

ingredients: Bread slices, milk, egg, sugar, butter, mixed berries
instructions: Whisk milk, eggs, and sugar until well combined. Dip bread slices into mixture, coating both sides evenly. Heat butter on a pan over medium heat. Cook soaked bread until golden brown on both sides. Warm berries lightly in the same pan. Serve toast topped with berries.

ingredients: Flour, butter, brown sugar, egg, dark chocolate
instructions: Cream butter and brown sugar until fluffy. Add egg and mix thoroughly. Fold in flour and chopped chocolate. Shape dough balls and chill for 15 minutes. Bake at 180C for 10 to 12 minutes until edges are set. Cool slightly before serving.

ingredients: Flour, butter, sugar, lemon juice, eggs
instructions: Prepare shortcrust pastry and line tart tin. Blind bake crust at 180C for 15 minutes. Whisk lemon juice, sugar, and eggs until smooth. Pour filling into baked crust. Bake again until filling sets. Cool completely before slicing.

ingredients: Milk, sugar, eggs, vanilla
instructions: Heat sugar until golden caramel forms. Pour caramel into mold and set aside. Heat milk gently with vanilla. Whisk eggs and pour warm milk slowly while stirring. Pour mixture into caramel mold. Steam or bake in water bath until set.

ingredients: Flour, yeast, milk, sugar, butter, cinnamon
instructions: Prepare yeast dough and let rise until doubled. Roll dough into rectangle. Spread butter, sugar, and cinnamon evenly. Roll tightly and slice into rolls. Bake until golden and fluffy. Cool slightly before serving.

ingredients: Condensed milk, cocoa powder, butter, sugar
instructions: Heat butter and condensed milk over low heat. Add cocoa powder and sugar, stirring constantly. Cook until thick and glossy. Pour into greased tray. Level surface evenly. Cool and cut into squares.

ingredients: Flour, butter, sugar, cream, strawberries
instructions: Bake soft sponge cake and allow to cool. Whip cream until soft peaks form. Slice strawberries and mix with sugar. Slice cake horizontally. Layer cake, cream, and strawberries. Chill briefly before serving.

ingredients: Milk, cream, sugar, vanilla
instructions: Heat milk, cream, and sugar until dissolved. Cool mixture completely. Add vanilla extract and mix. Pour into ice cream maker or freeze with periodic stirring. Continue freezing until creamy. Serve chilled.

ingredients: Peanut butter, sugar, egg
instructions: Mix peanut butter, sugar, and egg thoroughly. Shape dough into small balls. Flatten using fork. Arrange on baking tray. Bake until lightly browned. Cool before serving.

ingredients: Cream, sugar, gelatin, mango puree
instructions: Heat cream and sugar until dissolved. Add soaked gelatin and mix until smooth. Pour mixture into molds. Chill until set. Top with mango puree. Serve cold.

ingredients: Rice, milk, sugar, cardamom
instructions: Wash rice thoroughly. Boil milk and add rice. Cook until rice softens. Add sugar and cardamom. Transfer to baking dish. Bake until top sets.

ingredients: Bread, hazelnut chocolate spread, butter
instructions: Toast bread slices until crisp. Spread butter lightly while warm. Add hazelnut chocolate spread evenly. Allow spread to melt slightly. Cut diagonally if desired. Serve immediately.

ingredients: Flour, milk, sugar, yeast, butter
instructions: Prepare yeast dough and let rise. Roll dough and cut donut shapes. Place on baking tray and rest briefly. Bake until lightly golden. Brush with melted butter. Coat with sugar.

ingredients: Banana, flour, cocoa powder, sugar, butter
instructions: Mash ripe bananas until smooth. Mix with melted butter and sugar. Add flour and cocoa powder. Pour batter into loaf pan. Bake until toothpick comes out clean. Cool before slicing.
